    // basically it is a bunary serach
    public int searchInsert(int[] nums, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = nums.length-1;
        while(low<=high){
            int mid = (low+high)/2;
            if(nums[mid] == target)
               return mid;
            else if(nums[mid] > target)
               high = mid-1;
            else 
               low = mid+1;
        }
        return low;

        
    }
}
